transcription.verifiedBy: mechanical:textlayer+regions (mechanical check only: schema, text layer, printed figures; no second model, prompt mech-v1)
transcription.notes: The paper is the list of "vertical" clues of the IOAA 2013 team crossword: 17 lettered blocks A.–Q. (the catalogue lists titles only up to L, but the pages print A–Q), each with roman-numbered questions. Each question prints its points in square brackets followed by "- <answer>", the digits to enter in the grid; the points are in points and the printed answer is in answer.value (kept exactly as printed, e.g. "05", "0848", "0993"). No total is printed. Blanks printed as underscores are written as escaped underscores. Page 5: the comet photo collage of D.v is placed over the text of questions D.iii, D.iv and D.v, so only their roman labels and first letters are visible; their wording, points and answers are taken from the PDF text layer ("Rotation period of the Venus in Earth days. [3] - 243", "Number of Lagrangian points co-linear with the Sun-Earth radius vector [1] - 3", "Comet McNaught, Comet Shoemaker–Levy 9, Comet Hale–Bopp [3] - 214"). Page 7: a stray label "ι." is printed above F.ii (a leftover list marker); ignored. Page 2, B.iv: the option list 1. SBa … 9. Sc is set as an image; transcribed as text. Names kept as printed although misspelt: "Lunokhold 1" (F.vi, Lunokhod 1), "Saggitarius" (I.v), "Aristachus" (J.v), "Betlegeuse" (J.vi). Q.iii is labelled "iii," with a comma as printed. Q.v prints "97.2 μarcsec" (the text layer drops the μ). M.i prints the relation as R³~1/M.
